QuestInfo.name: [Dark Sea] Carved in the Heart
QuestInfo.0: Edea says you'll need #bGrendel the Really Old's#k expertise to investigate further. #bNeinheart#k agrees and plans to have Grendel escorted on the mission. Talk to Neinheart for more details.
QuestInfo.1: Go retrieve Grendel with Brighton. Even if he acted out of line in the past, Grendel is still an important member of the Alliance. Go to the Dark Sea together.
QuestInfo.2: You retrieved Grendel with Brighton. Even if he acted out of line in the past, Grendel is still an important member of the Alliance. Together, you went to the Dark Sea.
